label: French Cuff — 4 Buttonholes
description: A French cuff with four buttonholes is the conventional double-cuff arrangement, with two aligned holes on each leaf so a single cufflink passes cleanly through all four layers when folded. This is the standard cufflink closure and produces the familiar crisp, squared double cuff that frames the cufflink neatly. It offers a slightly cleaner, more traditional look than higher buttonhole counts while retaining full formality.
